entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. I need to return a VeloBand. Just give me the return label.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you with a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I tried doing this yesterday and your whole site was down.

Thank you, one moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 24th. I do apologize for the trouble yesterday. To make sure I process this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference, but that's irrelevant. I was within the return window yesterday when I tried. I got a 'website error' page and I couldn't print the label. I even took a screenshot.
I understand completely, and you are right to call in. We did have a known issue where our return system was down for several hours yesterday. I sincerely apologize that you were affected by that.
Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. I'm checking our knowledge base now... Okay, it looks straightforward. Our policy states a 90-day return window for a full refund.
Right. So you're sending the label?

Yes, absolutely. You're well within the timeframe. I have approved the return on my end. I am sending the email with the prepaid shipping label to you right now. You should see it in your inbox within a few minutes.
And since you are a VIP member and you had to deal with our system being down, I've gone ahead and added a $25 credit to your account for the inconvenience. You can use that on any future purchase.
Okay. The credit is fine. I see the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer. Have a wonderful day.
